answer_1.quote: In this paper, we first conduct a detailed study of exemplification across three different domains: Wikipedia, web articles, and community answers to questions from the ELI5 LFQA dataset. Next, we focus on improving the modeling and evaluation of the subtask of exemplification within LFQA.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate these rankings using recall@k of the ground-truth example (where k " 1, 3, 5, 10, 50, 100) from the set of all 66K examples in ELI5.

answer_4.quote: To explore this trade-off, we conduct a human evaluation by providing Mechanical Turk workers with an ELI5 question and context, and asking them to both rank and rate (on a 5 point Likert scale) three candidate exemplifying units.
answer_4.guideline: Workers ranked candidate exemplifying units and rated each on a 5-point Likert scale for how well it fits with the given context.
